payload.summary: Some pages render no main landmark: /dsm/search and /first-nations confirmed in a browser; admin pages need a full-load recheck
payload.detail: In a real browser on 2026-10-12 every sampled page had exactly one #main-content (no duplicates, desktop and phone), but /dsm/search and /first-nations contain no main element or role=main, so screen-reader landmark navigation has no main region there. A wider sweep of 195 static routes timed out on most pages (dev server compiles on demand), so the admin pages that also showed none are unconfirmed. Next action: confirm with a full-load axe landmark-one-main run over the static routes, then give each page without one a main root. Related: /cme/applications showed two main landmarks.
payload.source: Review of five Antigravity reports against main, 2026-10-12
